events.statement: Presented with three days of productive cough with yellow sputum, subjective fevers, and increasing shortness of breath on exertion; denied chest pain.

evidence.quote: presented to the emergency department with three days of productive cough with yellow sputum, subjective fevers and increasing shortness of breath on exertion. Denies chest pain.

events.statement: Chest X-ray showed right lower lobe consolidation and no pleural effusion.

evidence.quote: Chest X-ray shows right lower lobe consolidation. No pleural effusion.

events.statement: White blood cell count was 15.2 x10^9/L, C-reactive protein was 142 mg/L, and creatinine was 0.9 mg/dL.

evidence.quote: White blood cell count 15.2 x10^9/L. C-reactive protein 142 mg/L. Creatinine 0.9 mg/dL.

events.statement: Community-acquired pneumonia, right lower lobe, and hypertension were documented.

evidence.quote: Assessment documented: Community-acquired pneumonia, right lower lobe. Hypertension.

events.statement: Admitted to the medical ward and started intravenous Antibiotic B; blood cultures were drawn before the first antibiotic dose and sputum culture was requested.

evidence.quote: Pneumonia: Admit to medical ward. Start intravenous Antibiotic B. Blood cultures drawn before first antibiotic dose. Sputum culture requested.

events.statement: Supplemental oxygen by nasal cannula was planned to keep saturation above 92%; the night nursing note documented oxygen at 2 L/min with saturation 94%.

evidence.quote: Hypoxemia: Supplemental oxygen by nasal cannula to keep saturation above 92%.
Oxygen 2 L/min by nasal cannula, saturation 94%.

events.statement: Medication A 5 mg daily was ordered for hypertension; the night nursing note documented administration of the first dose of intravenous Antibiotic B at 22:15 with no reaction observed.

evidence.quote: Hypertension: Medication A 5 mg daily ordered.
First dose of intravenous Antibiotic B given at 22:15. No reaction observed.

events.statement: Patient reported less shortness of breath than on admission, with persistent cough and yellow sputum.

evidence.quote: Patient reports less shortness of breath than on admission. Cough persists with yellow sputum.

events.statement: White blood cell count was 12.1 x10^9/L and C-reactive protein was 96 mg/L; blood cultures showed no growth to date and sputum culture was pending.

evidence.quote: White blood cell count 12.1 x10^9/L. C-reactive protein 96 mg/L.
Blood cultures no growth to date. Sputum culture pending.

events.statement: Community-acquired pneumonia was documented as improving; hypertension was also documented.

evidence.quote: Community-acquired pneumonia, improving. Hypertension.

events.statement: Intravenous Antibiotic B was continued, and oxygen was weaned to 1 L/min with further weaning as tolerated planned.

evidence.quote: Pneumonia: Continue intravenous Antibiotic B. Follow cultures.
Hypoxemia: Oxygen weaned to 1 L/min; continue weaning as tolerated.

events.statement: White blood cell count was 9.4 x10^9/L and C-reactive protein was 51 mg/L; blood cultures showed no growth to date and sputum culture showed normal respiratory flora.

evidence.quote: White blood cell count 9.4 x10^9/L. C-reactive protein 51 mg/L.
Blood cultures no growth to date. Sputum culture: normal respiratory flora.

events.statement: The progress note documented switching intravenous Antibiotic B to oral Antibiotic B and discontinuing supplemental oxygen after hypoxemia was documented as resolved. The nursing note documented the first oral Antibiotic B dose.

evidence.quote: Pneumonia: Switch intravenous Antibiotic B to oral Antibiotic B.
Hypoxemia: Resolved. Supplemental oxygen discontinued.
First dose of oral Antibiotic B given.

events.statement: The progress note documented room-air oxygen saturation of 96%; nursing documented ambulation of 50 meters without oxygen and saturation of 95% after walking.

evidence.quote: Oxygen saturation 96% on room air.
Patient ambulated 50 meters in the hallway without oxygen; saturation 95% after walking.

events.statement: Medication A dose was documented as 10 mg daily in the progress note, while the nursing note documented Medication A 5 mg given that shift; the same-day dose documentation is conflicting.

evidence.quote: Medication A 10 mg daily.
Medication A 5 mg given this shift.

events.statement: Community-acquired pneumonia was documented as improved, and hypertension was documented.

evidence.quote: Community-acquired pneumonia, improved. Hypertension.

events.statement: At discharge, the patient was documented as clinically stable and improved, with mild residual cough and no shortness of breath at rest.

evidence.quote: Patient reports mild residual cough, no shortness of breath at rest.
Clinically stable, improved.

events.statement: Blood cultures had no growth to date with final results pending at discharge; sputum culture showed normal respiratory flora.

evidence.quote: Blood cultures no growth to date; final results pending at discharge. Sputum culture: normal respiratory flora.

events.statement: Discharged home with a plan to complete oral Antibiotic B for a total of 7 days of antibiotic therapy; Medication A was continued.

evidence.quote: Discharge home today.
Pneumonia: Complete oral Antibiotic B for a total of 7 days of antibiotic therapy.
Hypertension: Medication A continued.

events.statement: Primary care clinic follow-up in 1 week and repeat chest X-ray in 6 weeks were planned; the primary care clinic was to follow up final blood culture results.

evidence.quote: Follow up with primary care clinic in 1 week.
Repeat chest X-ray in 6 weeks.
Final blood culture results pending at discharge; primary care clinic to follow up.
